children: AB InBev's strategy can deliver growth in the years ahead, analysts at Bank of America tell clients in a note. The Bud Light brewer detailed the evolution of its strategy at an investor day in St. Louis, Missouri, this week. "AB InBev has further strengthened its commercial and digital capabilities, positioning the company to sustainably deliver and compound best-in-class earnings growth and free cash flow," BofA says. The bank points to the company's scale and portfolio among the elements of its competitive advantage versus peers. (joshua.kirby@wsj.com; @joshualeokirby)
